title: He Can't F*ck This Up
description:
Negotiations between the United States and Iran just stalled in Geneva, and the signals coming out of the region are escalating fast. The U.S. Embassy in Israel told staff to leave. China is urging its citizens to evacuate Iran. F-22s are now in Israel for the first time ever, and the U.S. has begun its largest naval buildup in the region since 2003.

So what is the real goal here? Are we trying to stop Iran’s nuclear ambitions, or are we heading toward another endless conflict in the Middle East?
